positive: Fix this C# service where a scoped dependency is captured by a singleton. Preserve request isolation and verify disposal through the actual dependency-injection container.
A .NET library's nullable annotations promise a value that deserialization can omit. Align the runtime validation and public type contract without breaking documented JSON inputs.
Our C# event publisher keeps subscribers alive after a window closes. Establish subscription ownership and test repeated open/close cycles for retained handlers.
A dotnet package builds locally but fails when trimmed for deployment. Identify reflection-dependent entry points and verify the published artifact instead of only the development build.
Repair a C# task pipeline that blocks on Result inside an asynchronous request handler. Preserve exception and cancellation behavior while removing the deadlock.
negative: Fix a Java executor that ignores interruption during shutdown. This service contains no managed Windows runtime or interop boundary.
Review a C++ allocator mismatch between a plugin and its host. Both sides are native libraries and no managed wrapper is involved.
Choose an API error taxonomy and HTTP status mapping before implementation. Do not select an implementation language or change application code.
Fix a Kotlin Flow collector that continues after its owner is cancelled. The target is an Android application and not a .NET service.
Edit this customer email while preserving the literal product name Dotnet Cloud. Use only the supplied text; no runtime investigation is needed.

ambiguous.prompt: Our C# gRPC service accepts a newly added protobuf field but older clients lose its presence distinction. Review both the generated .NET behavior and schema evolution policy.
A .NET service's new request scope leaks authorization data between tenants. Repair its object lifetimes and test the authorization boundary independently.
Upgrade the dotnet library's target framework and revise the release plan for existing consumers. Verify which API and packaging changes require coordinated rollout.
